pages.text:
Some deposits are sour: high in sulfur. They give Sour Crude Oil, crude's dark brown with a yellowish cast. About 30% of deposits are sour, 60% in badlands and deserts (both in config). The Seismic Survey Tool tells you.
The Distillation Array refines Sour Crude Oil like Crude Oil, but its Diesel and Kerosene come out sour: Sour Diesel and Sour Kerosene.
# Burning sour fuel
The Fuel Burner and the Firebox Array take them at 75% of the heat and 100°C cooler: Sour Diesel 315 HU/mB up to 1,050°C, Sour Kerosene 285 HU/mB up to 1,050°C. The Diesel Generator, the Gas Turbine Array and the Jetpack refuse them.

# Hydrotreater
Treats sour fuel with Hydrogen to take the sulfur out.
- 100 mB Sour Diesel or Sour Kerosene and 30 mB Hydrogen make 100 mB Diesel or Kerosene and 30 mB Hydrogen Sulfide in 2 seconds, using 20 HU/t at 300°C or hotter and 20 FE/t.
- Sour fuel and Hydrogen in the top, heat into the bottom, FE in the back. The clean fuel leaves by the left, the Hydrogen Sulfide by the right; it pushes both out on its own.
- Speed Upgrades make it faster, drawing heat and FE that much faster.
Hydrogen Sulfide is a poisonous gas: send it to a Sulfur Recovery Unit, or burn it off in a Flare Stack.

# Sulfur
Sour crude is a real source of Sulfur. 1,000 mB distilled 14 high gives 190 mB Sour Kerosene and 155 mB Sour Diesel; hydrotreated, they give off about 104 mB Hydrogen Sulfide, and the Sulfur Recovery Unit turns that into about one Sulfur Dust (10 high: 102 mB, the same). Sulfur cures Rubber and makes Sulfuric Acid.
